messages:
Elena Ruiz: quick UX pulse 1 invite flow feels confusing when org SSO is optional. customers keep sending invites then seeing a failure modal after the fact. idea: surface an 'SSO compatibility' prompt inline during email entry and show quick remediation steps before send. thoughts?
Marcus Liu: inline check makes sense. make it lightweight: check domain mx/known-org mapping and SSO status. show three states: OK, Enforced (requires SSO), Unknown (ask to check). small spinner while checking. non-blocking by default.
Priya Desai: naming: unify to 'Enforce SSO' everywhere in controls. inline tag copy: 'Enforce SSO for domain' is awkward. propose: tag reads 'SSO enforced for domain.com' or 'SSO optional'. keep it short and consistent.
Yusuf Ahmed: perf note: domain lookup on every keystroke can be chatty. debounce 250ms and cache results per-domain. fallback to a manual 'Check' button if backend times out. show spinner/aria-busy indicator for SRs.
Elena Ruiz: accessibility: the inline status must use aria-live=polite and also expose an explicit button 'Why?' that opens a dialog with role="dialog" explaining differences (pending vs create). dialog should grab focus, be dismissible with ESC, and return focus to the email input after close.
Priya Desai: deep-link to Audit Log: add 'Audit: related events' link in the invite modal that opens filtered logs in a new tab. microcopy: label it 'Open audit (filtered)'. when opened, announce a non-modal toast in the original tab: 'Audit opened in new tab'. ensure rel="noopener" and SR-friendly description 'Opens Audit Log in new tab, filtered by email'.
Marcus Liu: implementers note: don't include raw email in query param by default. use a short-lived token referencing the server-side filter. if user explicitly checks 'Include email in link', allow it but warn about PII in the tooltip.
Yusuf Ahmed: keyboard flow: g i opens invite modal (consistent). within modal: tab order should be email -> role -> SSO status tag -> why? -> send. don't auto-focus send on open. If SSO status is 'Enforced' show a non-blocking caution row above send that is focusable (aria-live) and requires explicit acknowledgement only if user chooses 'Create account' instead of 'Send invite'.
Elena Ruiz: microcopy tweaks: replace 'Require SSO for org' with 'Enforce SSO for this org' on toggles and 'Members must sign in with your SSO' as helper text. Inline tag states: 'SSO enforced', 'SSO optional', 'Unknown'.
Priya Desai: print/export behavior: audit deep-links should not expose PII in URL; exported CSV can include emails but modal must show a clear checkbox 'Include email addresses in export' (unchecked by default). tooltips explain retention policy.
Yusuf Ahmed: role matrix interaction: pending invites should surface a 'jump to invite' action that opens the audit deep-link and highlights the invite events. highlight should include 2 events before/after and a visible focus outline. if event pruned by retention, show 'Event no longer available' message.
A11yBot: checklist reminder: aria-live for inline status, dialog role + focus trap for Why? dialog, announce audit tab open, no PII in URLs by default, contrast >=4.5:1 for status tags, keyboard order preserved, and test with NVDA/VoiceOver.
Elena Ruiz: next steps: Marcus -> API token + caching plan; Yusuf -> keyboard/tab order prototype + highlight behavior; Priya -> final microcopy and dialog copy; I'll update Figma with the inline tag, dialog, and audit-link CTA. target: review Fri morning. :calendar:
